summary_ja: 届出の懈怠または承認基準を満たさない場合に、金融庁長官がシナリオ法の承認を取り消すことができる場合を定める。
summary_en: Provides that the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may revoke approval for the scenario method where a required notification is neglected or approval standards are not met.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company has neglected to give the notification under item (ii) of paragraph (1) of the preceding Article, or where item (iii) of that paragraph applies, and the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency determines that it is inappropriate for that Ultimate Designated Parent Company to continue to use the scenario method, the Commissioner may revoke the approval under Article 279, paragraph (1) with respect to that Ultimate Designated Parent Company.
